methods.name: Exact complete split-affine Newton root-selector chambers
capabilities: represent a complete split-affine real-root inventory with fixed declared root multiplicity
check fixed-multiplicity noncollision at rational parameter points
construct smallest-positive Boolean affine selector chambers
evaluate exact selector predicates at rational parameter points
materialize the monic factorized polynomial exactly
verify a supplied rational polynomial matches the split certificate up to a nonzero scalar
typed_inputs: fixed declared rational root and positive multiplicity
finite rational-affine real-root branches with positive multiplicities
optional rational polynomial for split-certificate matching
typed_outputs: selector stability decision at a parameter point
reuse: existing exact rational root/Sturm regression machinery
methods.hard_boundary: A complete split-affine real-root certificate is required. This is not a factorization algorithm or a general parametric Sturm/subresultant chamber solver. Selector-value stability does not replace T59 declared multiplicity/schedule validity; smallest-real and smallest-positive semantics remain distinct.
